headline: ANJE president on whether the DR has called for discussion of reforms
summary: The Dominican government's supplementary budget review faces rising public spending and fiscal deficit. The pressure stems from international crisis effects linked to armed conflicts and higher hydrocarbon prices.
why: Budget deficits and public spending levels shape sovereign debt issuance and the fiscal outlook that investors use to assess sovereign risk.
original_headline: Presidente de ANJE no que en RD haya llamado para discutir reformas
